# Calder — transactional email infrastructure

Calder provides an HTTP API for application emails such as verification codes,
password resets, receipts and notifications. A 202 response means the request
was queued, not that it was delivered. Test keys simulate sending. Live sending
requires an eligible sender and correctly configured delivery infrastructure.

The free plan has a 5,000-email monthly allowance and includes a small Calder
footer on outgoing messages. See pricing for current limits. Paid checkout is
not available. SMTP is not a public service. Gmail OAuth integration exists in
source, but production approval, configuration and availability are not verified.
Marketing functionality is in development. Official SDK package publication
has not been verified; use the direct HTTP quickstarts.
